plan.title: DocMonk Improvement Roadmap: harden, ship 1.0, product, architecture

context.summary: DocMonk is feature-complete for local mode and technically healthy, but not ready for v1.0.0: shipped releases carry open TLS advisories and installs that never verify signatures, the only multilingual eval has no human-reviewed labels or floors, server-mode measurements are missing, and multilingual retrieval is opt-in and hard to install.

baseline.source: local run of cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast on b9f38da

baseline.scope: held-out, SQLite, 12 unanswerable queries, every report

baseline.metric: evidence recall@10 on English queries, MiniLM vs E5

baseline.scope: default dev profile, 47 test binaries over 200 MB
6 TLS (rustls x4, rustls-webpki, webpki-roots), 3 zip (extract-only); plus 2 informational

findings.summary: Open RustSec advisories in the TLS stack used by docmonk-update, docmonk-ai and docmonk-backends: rustls 0.23.45 (RUSTSEC-2026-0346/0347/0348/0349), rustls-webpki 0.103.15 (RUSTSEC-2026-0382), webpki-roots 1.0.9 (RUSTSEC-2026-0381). zip 1.1.4 and 8.6.0 have RUSTSEC-2026-0367/0368/0369, which affect only ZipArchive::extract and ZipStreamReader::extract.
No cargo-deny or cargo-audit in any workflow.
The README one-liner downloads install.sh from main, where the minisign key is empty, so signatures are never checked; with a key set, a missing minisign tool only prints a note.

evidence.note: injects the key only into dist/ copies

findings.summary: Secret filtering is filename-only with 8 patterns; indexed text is never redacted and is served through MCP.
All 100 held-out labels are model-authored and pending review, and the held-out floors are empty, so the only multilingual eval gates nothing.
Server-mode measurements are missing: ADR 0035 live numbers; ADR 0041 held-out on three backends and paged-embedding memory; ledger F10 (8k/50k live gate) and F12 (cache loss, two-host writers).
Local ANN recall was recorded at ef_search=96 while the default is 400.
multilingual-e5-small can only be installed with a repository shell script; the README does not mention it.
documents.chunking.max_tokens auto always resolves to 256 and is counted with the MiniLM tokenizer, so E5 (512) gets half-size chunks.
The English cross-encoder lowers multilingual results (E5 recall@1 0.875 to 0.799, cross-language recall@10 1.0 to 0.846) and costs about 1.5 s p95.
Layering leaks: docmonk-ml depends on docmonk-storage and docmonk-indexing; docmonk-convert depends on docmonk-code, docmonk-knowledge and docmonk-ml.
Very large functions on the hottest paths: evidence_value 451 lines, explore_ranked 447, literal_content 395, health::problems 326; 20 production functions exceed 150 lines.
docmonk-ops (backup, restore, rebuild, uninstall, vectors; 1,065 lines) has a single test.
MCP exposes 10 tools; the CLI's references and link commands have no MCP counterpart and agents cannot fetch a cited span.
docs/clean-slate-inventory.md still exists although the baseline is empty; docs/ui.md still describes services as docmonk.service.*.
Code intelligence links HTTP routes across sources but has no rules for message brokers.
Remaining held-out failures with E5: h099 (unanswerable reported supported) and the one-word ambiguous queries h085, h087, h088.
Embedding runs on CPU only: 35 texts/s (MiniLM) and 17 texts/s (E5), 24-49 minutes for 50k chunks.
Sources are local or network folders only; there is no git remote source kind.
A debug test build reaches 28 GB because each of 125 test binaries statically links candle, rten and tokenizers with full debug info.

Ledger residuals limit multi-host server mode: discovery needs a checkout (F04), CAS relies on the lease (F05), host-local retry state (F08), uninterruptible model batches (F09), no UI rate limiting (F11).
62% of commits come from Claude sessions; code, eval labels and gates can all come from the same model.

do_not_duplicate.summary: Held-out eval harness with per-arm metrics, approved-only floors and a label-file SHA check.
Optional multilingual-e5-small profile with query/passage prefixes in the model fingerprint (ADR 0040).
Minisign verification in docmonk update and SHA256SUMS signing in the release workflow when the secret exists.
Admin UI Host-header, CSRF and Origin/Referer checks; non-loopback binds refused without remote mode.
Greek lexical normalization: accent folding, final sigma, light stemmer (ADR 0039).
Live filtered ANN recall test for OpenSearch and Elasticsearch.
Safe archive unpacking in docmonk-update (enclosed_name, own placement, mode masked to 0o755); ZipArchive::extract is not used.
Single storage-mode resolver and the KnowledgeRead port shared by SQLite and server backends.

rules: Branch from the latest main after every depends_on package is merged.
Keep security, retrieval-quality and refactor changes in separate PRs.
Split a work package into several PRs when one would be too large to review in one sitting; keep the work package id in every PR title.

protected_paths.reason: Held-out labels judge the code; a model must not approve its own labels.
Floors only move up, with human approval.
Finding statuses are claims about verification.
Must stay empty for the release gate.
Audits are never weakened to get CI green.

principles: Inspect current main before each work package; adapt the plan where the code has moved instead of applying it blindly.
Measure before and after; never claim an improvement without a committed report.
Keep determinism: identical rankings, citations and verdicts on repeated runs over the same snapshot.
Any change to stored text, tokenization or embeddings updates the relevant fingerprint so affected sources rebuild; schema changes follow ADR 0032.
Record design decisions as new ADRs in docs/adr/ with the next free number.
Prefer the smallest change that meets the acceptance criteria.
non_goals: No new storage backend and no hosted or cloud service.
No telemetry; user eval data stays local.
No change to the ADR 0032 clean-slate policy: no code reads or converts earlier homes, databases or indexes.
No lowering of floors or loosening of audits to land a change.
No reranker enabled by default until it beats the semantic arm in every category.
No change of the default embedding model before decision D2 is recorded.

fetch_models.purpose: Download and verify the pinned embedding, reranker, OCR and E5 models.

test.purpose: Workspace tests with pinned models required, as in CI.

audits.run: cargo xtask clean-slate-audit && cargo xtask branding-audit
audits.purpose: Repository audits every new line must pass.

eval_default.purpose: Held-out eval with the default embedding model; attach the report.

eval_e5.purpose: Held-out eval with multilingual-e5-small; attach the report.

requires.description: OpenSearch 2.17 on :9201 and Elasticsearch 8.15 on :9202 (the service containers of .github/workflows/rust.yml)

validate_plan.purpose: Validate this plan against its schema after every edit; then re-check x-integrity-rules by reading.

low_disk.purpose: Keep debug builds small on machines with under 40 GB free until A3 lands.

objectives.objective: Close the security exposure of releases people can install today.
success_criteria: cargo deny check passes with only documented, expiring ignores.
Installers and docmonk update refuse tampered or unsigned releases when a key is configured.
No planted secret is retrievable through any read surface.

objectives.objective: Ship v1.0.0 with human-verified quality gates.
success_criteria: Floors on approved held-out labels run nightly on all three backends.
v1.0.0 signed and installable on Linux, macOS and Windows.
E5 installable with one command on every platform.
False support 0 and false abstention below 0.10 on approved labels.

objectives.objective: Widen what DocMonk indexes and what agents can do through MCP.
success_criteria: Git remote sources and messaging topology land with tests.
Agents can follow citations to spans and linked code through MCP alone.

objectives.objective: Reduce structural debt with behaviour-preserving refactors.
success_criteria: The layer table is enforced in CI.
A full debug test build stays under 8 GB.
Gate and label files require code-owner approval.
At least 300 approved queries with a sealed split; mutation score tracked.

work_packages.title: Patch TLS advisories and document zip non-applicability
work_packages.purpose: Remove the six open RustSec advisories in rustls, rustls-webpki and webpki-roots from the lockfile and record why the zip advisories do not apply until upstream crates move.

tasks.title: Update TLS crates
tasks.details: cargo update -p rustls -p rustls-webpki -p webpki-roots to the latest semver-compatible releases (at least rustls 0.23.46, rustls-webpki 0.103.16, webpki-roots 1.0.10). Use --precise only if a plain update does not reach the patched versions.

tasks.title: Assess zip
tasks.details: zip 1.1.4 comes from candle-core 0.9.1 (pinned =0.9.1) and zip 8.6.0 from calamine, docling, docmonk-update and xtask. RUSTSEC-2026-0367/0368/0369 are fixed only in zip >= 9.0.0 and concern ZipArchive::extract and ZipStreamReader::extract. Grep the workspace to confirm neither is called. If docmonk-update and xtask can move to zip 9 without breaking calamine/docling, do it; otherwise write the justification that H2 will put in deny.toml.

tasks.title: Verify
tasks.details: Run the full test suite with pinned models; rely on the CI server-integration job for OpenSearch/Elasticsearch transport.

tests: cargo test --workspace with DOCMONK_REQUIRE_MODELS=1 and DOCMONK_REQUIRE_OCR=1

acceptance.criterion: A RustSec scan of Cargo.lock reports no rustls, rustls-webpki or webpki-roots advisories.
The zip advisories are fixed, or documented with why they do not apply and which upstream crates block the bump.

deliverables: zip justification text for H2's deny.toml
work_packages.rollback: Revert the lockfile commit.
notes: cargo deny also found RUSTSEC-2026-0386 (tokio AsyncFd, unsound); tokio was bumped to 1.54.1 in the same work package.

zip stays: zip 1.1.4 is pinned by candle-core =0.9.1 and zip 8 by calamine; neither the workspace nor those crates call ZipArchive::extract or ZipStreamReader::extract. The ignores in deny.toml carry the reason and a 2027-01-31 review date.

work_packages.title: cargo-deny in CI and a nightly advisory run
work_packages.purpose: Catch new advisories, licence violations and duplicate or untrusted sources automatically, including advisories published between PRs.

tasks.title: deny.toml
tasks.details: advisories: deny vulnerabilities, warn unmaintained/unsound, ignore list only for the zip ids from H1 with a reason and an expiry date; licenses: an allowlist compatible with MIT per ADR 0003; bans: warn on multiple versions; sources: crates.io only.

tasks.title: CI step
tasks.details: Add cargo-deny (EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny-action pinned by commit SHA) to the Repository audits job so every PR runs it, and add deny.toml to the classifier's 'all three' paths with a self-test case.

tasks.title: Nightly advisories
tasks.details: A nightly job runs cargo deny check advisories against main and opens or updates a single issue on failure.

tasks.title: Docs
tasks.details: Document the job in docs/CI.md and the policy in ADR 0003.

acceptance.criterion: A PR introducing a crate with an open advisory fails CI.
A nightly advisory run exists and reports failures to one issue.

work_packages.rollback: Remove the cargo-deny steps; keep deny.toml.
notes: H2-AC1 was checked locally: cargo deny check failed on the then-open tokio advisory until it was patched.
MPL-2.0 is allowed only as per-crate exceptions (cssparser, cssparser-macros, dtoa-short, selectors).
H2-AC2 stays open until the nightly advisory job has run on main.

work_packages.title: Fail-closed install and update verification

requires.description: Confirm or add the minisign signing secret, its password and the public-key variable.

work_packages.purpose: Make the README one-liners and docmonk update verify the release signature and refuse to install when verification cannot run.

tasks.title: confirm signing secrets
tasks.details: Confirm the signing secret and public-key variable exist in the repository settings; if not, generate a minisign key pair offline and add them. Claude Code stops and asks if it cannot confirm this.

tasks.title: Commit the public key
tasks.details: Put the public key into install.sh and install.ps1 on main. The release workflow's sed step becomes a check that the committed key equals vars.MINISIGN_PUBLIC_KEY.

tasks.title: Fail closed
tasks.details: With a key set, a missing minisign tool or a missing/invalid SHA256SUMS.minisig aborts the install with instructions; DOCMONK_INSECURE_SKIP_SIGNATURE=1 is the only explicit opt-out and prints a warning. Same behaviour in PowerShell.

tasks.title: docmonk update
tasks.details: Confirm that with a compiled-in key a missing or invalid signature is an error in crates/docmonk-update; add tests for both cases.

tasks.title: Release workflow
tasks.details: Fail the release when the key is configured but no SHA256SUMS.minisig was produced, and verify the signature with the public key before publishing.

tasks.title: Installer CI
tasks.details: Extend the install-script job on ubuntu, macos and windows with a tampered SHA256SUMS case and a missing-signature case; both must exit non-zero.

tests: install-script CI job: tampered checksum, missing signature, valid signature

acceptance.criterion: install.sh, install.ps1 and docmonk update refuse a tampered or unsigned release when a key is configured.
The README install instructions verify the signature by default.

deliverables: Committed public key in both installers
work_packages.rollback: Revert the installer changes; the release workflow keeps signing as before.
notes: Blocked on H3-01 (human): v0.3.25 is unsigned and no minisign key is configured, so no public key could be committed (H3-02). The installers stay checksums-only, with a warning, until a maintainer commits the key to install.sh and install.ps1 and sets vars.MINISIGN_PUBLIC_KEY plus the secrets. The release workflow then verifies that the committed key and the variable match.

Fail-closed logic is tested with a throwaway key: unit tests in docmonk-update, and tampered, unsigned and no-minisign cases in the install-script CI job on all three platforms. DOCMONK_MINISIGN_PUBKEY overrides the key for tests and mirrors.

work_packages.title: Keep secrets out of the index
work_packages.purpose: Stop credentials in indexed files from being stored, embedded or returned through search, evidence, the Admin UI or MCP.

tasks.title: Filename patterns
tasks.details: Extend SECRET_FILENAME_PATTERNS with .netrc, .git-credentials, .npmrc, kubeconfig, *.kubeconfig, id_ecdsa, id_dsa, *.pfx, *.p12, *.jks, *.keystore, *.kdbx, *.tfstate. Add an indexing.secret_patterns setting that extends, never replaces, the built-in list.

tasks.title: Content redaction
tasks.details: A docmonk-core secrets module applied to every text before it is stored or embedded (chunk text, passages, entity bodies, document metadata): private key blocks, cloud access keys, GitHub/GitLab/Slack tokens, JWTs, password/secret/api-key assignments, connection strings with Password= or Pwd=, URLs with credentials. Replace only the secret value with [REDACTED:<kind>] on the same line so line numbers and citations stay valid.

tasks.title: Fingerprint and config
tasks.details: Include the redaction rule-set version in the chunker/passage fingerprint so existing sources rebuild. indexing.redact_secrets defaults to true, with a per-source override.

tasks.title: Fixture and tests
tasks.details: A fixture corpus with planted secrets in code, appsettings JSON, Markdown, a PDF and an email attachment; tests that search, evidence, explore, documents, MCP tools and the UI document view never return them.

tests: new secrets fixture across all read surfaces

acceptance.criterion: No planted secret is retrievable through search, evidence, explore, documents, MCP or the UI.
Citations still verify and held-out metrics are unchanged.

work_packages.rollback: Set indexing.redact_secrets: false and rebuild; revert to remove the code.
notes: H4-03 is partly done: the rule-set version is in the parser/chunker identities and the graph derivation, and indexing.redact_secrets defaults to true. The per-source override is not implemented, because source records have no per-source settings and adding one is a control schema change (ADR 0042).
The UI document view reads the same stored, redacted text; the tests cover the service and every MCP tool.
Held-out report: benchmarks/heldout-eval/h4-secret-redaction.json. All metrics are identical to phase-3.json on SQLite.

work_packages.title: Per-source MCP visibility and an MCP query log
work_packages.purpose: Let users keep sensitive sources searchable from the CLI and UI while hiding them from AI agents, and see what agents asked.

tasks.title: Visibility flag
tasks.details: A per-source mcp: true|false (default true), applied as a hard filter at candidate generation for every MCP tool, including graph traversals across sources (impact, callers, callees) and ask citations.

tasks.title: Query log
tasks.details: Opt-in mcp.query_log writes JSON lines to <home>/logs/mcp.jsonl: time, tool, redacted arguments, result count, sources touched; size-based rotation.

tests: a hidden source never appears in any MCP tool result

acceptance.criterion: No docmonk_* tool returns a record or source name from a hidden source.

work_packages.rollback: Revert; the flag defaults to visible so configs stay valid.
notes: Adapted: the visibility flag is mcp.hidden_sources (source ids or paths) in config rather than a per-source field, which would have been a control schema change. Hidden sources are left out by open_sources inside a per-call scope, and every answer is also scrubbed.

tasks.title: Floors

heldout-gates.json has floors for SQLite and, when run, both engines; metrics_approved_only is non-null.

tasks.title: Failure reporting
tasks.details: Fail on any floor and open or update one issue with the failing metrics.

tests: workflow_dispatch run of the nightly job

work_packages.purpose: Verify server-mode publication at scale so it can ship as GA rather than preview (decision D1).

tasks.details: Run the graph and publication benchmarks against live engines and fill the ADR's Measurement section.

tasks.title: Ledger
tasks.details: Propose status updates for F10 and F12 in audit/remediation/ledger.json; a human approves.

A nightly benchmark gate (T08.3) runs against live engines.

work_packages.title: Local ANN recall at the default ef_search
work_packages.purpose: Replace the stale recall figure and justify the default with a recall/latency curve.

tasks.title: Sweep
tasks.details: Measure recall@10 and p50/p95 at ef_search 64, 96, 200, 400 and 800 for 20k and 100k vectors, release build.

tasks.title: Default
tasks.details: Choose the lowest-latency setting with recall@10 >= 0.95; change the default only if the sweep says so and note it in ADR 0014.

acceptance.criterion: benchmarks/ann-sweep.json covers 20k and 100k vectors at five ef_search values.
The default ef_search is the lowest-latency setting with recall@10 >= 0.95.

work_packages.rollback: Revert the default change if any.
notes: At 20k vectors ef_search 400 is the lowest-latency setting with recall@10 >= 0.95 (0.961), so the default is unchanged. At 100k no measured setting reaches 0.95 (800 gives 0.809) on the synthetic set; ADR 0014 records this as open (a build-side change, and a measurement on real embeddings).

tasks.details: docmonk models list | install <slug> | verify: download the pinned files from the manifest (model id + revision), verify every SHA-256 against the manifest, write atomically under <home>/models/<slug>, honour proxy settings, and support --from <dir> for offline installs.

work_packages.title: Model-aware chunk budget
work_packages.purpose: Use the active embedder's real input limit instead of MiniLM's 256 tokens.

tasks.title: Resolve auto per model
tasks.details: max_tokens auto = the active model's max input minus safety tokens, counted with that model's tokenizer; the tokenizer identity is part of the chunker fingerprint.

tasks.title: Evaluate
tasks.details: Held-out with E5 at 256, 384 and 512; adopt under a rule fixed before reading the numbers: no category or language loses more than 0.05 recall@10 and line provenance does not drop.

acceptance.criterion: An ADR records the chunk budget chosen from held-out runs at 256, 384 and 512 tokens with E5.
No category or language loses more than 0.05 recall@10 and line provenance does not drop.

work_packages.rollback: Pin documents.chunking.max_tokens to 256; revert the resolver.

work_packages.title: A reranker that fits the embedder
work_packages.purpose: Stop the English cross-encoder from degrading multilingual results; adopt a multilingual one only if it helps.

tasks.title: Language guard
tasks.details: When the embedding model is multilingual and the reranker is English-only, skip reranking and report a skipped_language_mismatch state in explain output.

tasks.title: Multilingual candidate
tasks.details: Run a compatibility check and the held-out eval for a multilingual cross-encoder candidate (for example the mMARCO multilingual MiniLM cross-encoder; verify the exact model id, revision and licence). Adopt only if the reranked arm is at least the semantic arm in every category and p95 at most 2x.

acceptance.criterion: The reranked arm is at least the semantic arm in every category on approved labels, or reranking is skipped for that model.
Explain output reports skipped_language_mismatch when it applies.

work_packages.rollback: Revert; the reranker stays off by default.

work_packages.title: Abstention and ambiguity
work_packages.purpose: Fix the remaining held-out failures: false support, false abstention and one-word ambiguous queries.

tasks.title: False support
tasks.details: Case h099 ('what is the GraphQL rate limit per minute' reported supported by services/shipping/rates.py): require the question's rare anchor terms to be covered by the supporting evidence before reporting supported.

tasks.title: Ambiguity
tasks.details: Cases h085, h087, h088 (refund, retention, approval): for single-term ambiguous queries return evidence grouped by meaning (code vs policy documents) with an ambiguous flag.

tasks.title: False abstention
tasks.details: Analyse the answerable queries reported insufficient_evidence and adjust thresholds on the dev split only.

acceptance.criterion: False support 0 and false abstention below 0.10 on approved sealed labels, with no category regression.

work_packages.rollback: Revert the evidence changes.

work_packages.title: Faster indexing
work_packages.purpose: Cut first-index time for large corpora, especially with E5.

tasks.title: Accelerators
tasks.details: candle metal feature for the macOS aarch64 release and an optional cuda build feature, with CPU fallback.

tasks.title: Precision and batching
tasks.details: Evaluate f16/int8 weights and batch autotuning; device and precision join the model fingerprint unless a parity test shows cosine >= 0.999 against CPU f32.

tasks.title: ETA
tasks.details: Show an ETA in docmonk status from rolling embedding throughput.

acceptance.criterion: At least 3x embedding throughput on Apple silicon.
Cosine parity >= 0.999 against CPU f32, or device and precision are part of the fingerprint.
docmonk status shows an ETA during embedding.

work_packages.rollback: Build without the accelerator features.
notes: P5-03 (ETA) is implemented: embedding progress per page, indexer.workers[].embedding with rate_per_second and eta_seconds, shown in the status text view.

P5-01 (Metal/CUDA) and P5-02 (f16/int8, batch autotuning) are open: building and measuring them needs Apple-silicon or CUDA hardware (the 3x target and the >= 0.999 cosine parity), which the agent environment does not have.

decisions.question: Server mode in 1.0: GA or preview?
decisions.recommendation: Preview, unless R4 passes before R7.
decisions.rationale: Local mode is the main use and is fully verified; server mode has no live numbers yet.

decisions.question: Default embedding model
options: Switch to multilingual-e5-small with a lite profile
decisions.recommendation: Switch to multilingual-e5-small once P1 and P2 land and Q2 confirms it; keep all-MiniLM-L6-v2 as a fast lite profile.
decisions.rationale: E5 is better on every language measured, English included (B10), at about 3x build time, 4x memory and a 470 MB model.

decisions.question: Ship E5 bundled or on demand?
options: On demand plus an optional full asset
decisions.recommendation: On demand via docmonk models install, plus an optional full release asset.
decisions.rationale: Keeps the base download small while offline installs remain possible.

decisions.question: Reranker
decisions.recommendation: Keep it off by default; adopt a multilingual cross-encoder only if P4 shows ranking, not recall, is the remaining gap.
decisions.rationale: The English reranker costs about 1.5 s p95 and lowers multilingual results (V10).

risks.risk: Self-confirming quality: the same model writes code, labels and floors.
risks.mitigation: Q1 ownership rules, R1 human review, Q2 sealed split, floors never lowered.

risks.risk: Content redaction changes stored text and rankings.
risks.mitigation: Redact only secret values on the same line, version the rule set in fingerprints, require unchanged held-out reports.

risks.risk: Fail-closed installs block users without minisign.
risks.mitigation: Per-platform instructions and an explicit, loud DOCMONK_INSECURE_SKIP_SIGNATURE=1 opt-out.

risks.risk: Switching the default model slows indexing and raises memory.
risks.mitigation: Decide only after P1, P2, P5 and Q2; keep a lite profile; show an ETA.
Byte-identical eval and golden reports before and after.

risks.risk: Server-mode work needs clusters that are not always available.
risks.mitigation: Use the CI service containers; decision D1 keeps the release unblocked.

risks.risk: zip advisories stay open because upstream crates pin older majors.
risks.mitigation: Documented, expiring cargo-deny ignores and upstream tracking; extract() stays unused.

agent_prompt: Implement plans/improvement-roadmap.json in https://github.com/gzarog/DocMonk. It follows plans/plan.schema.json; read both fully, then inspect current main (the plan was written against b9f38da, v0.3.25) and adapt where the code has moved. Work in execution.order, starting with execution.start_with, one roadmap/ branch and one PR per work package, respecting depends_on. Do only tasks whose executor (task-level, else work-package-level) is not human; for claude_code_then_human_review, open the PR and stop for review; for claude_code_with_cluster, use the service containers from .github/workflows/rust.yml. Obey policy.protected_paths and execution.stop_and_ask_when. Every PR runs all keys in its verification.commands and must pass the clean-slate and branding audits; attach before/after held-out reports when eval_report_required is true. Never decide D1-D4 yourself. Report each PR as execution.pr_report says, and update status fields and progress_log in this file as execution.status_updates says, validating with commands.validate_plan.
